gameLocalization.note: Enemy skills and blue/yellow Honorable Duel are checked against paired Canto VII records; Mental Fracture uses its shared status record. Unconfirmed values remain unconfirmed.

shortName.text: The Knight of the White Moon

stageName.text: On the Vivid Clash Between the Knight of the White Moon and the Valiant Don Quixote

lead.text: A scripted encounter with only LCB Sinner Don Quixote. Special stat modifiers apply, and a sequence ends the fight after combat begins on Turn 6. Clash against attacks with extra damage and check the final switch to E.G.O.

listLead.text: An event battle with 1 fixed combatant. Clash against attacks with additional damage and use the special stat bonuses.

statNote.text: Data for the 7-26 scripted encounter only. Enemy HP, level, Defense Level, and Speed are unknown. All resistances are estimated as neutral, but remain displayed as unknown rather than confirmed values. Your Sinner is adjusted to Lv.50 and Uptie IV, with her base E.G.O at Threadspin IV.

skillNote.text: Enemy Power and levels are hidden in-game. Power values from “Dragon of the Spring” through “Blak Arwe”, and Lv.50 on skills other than “Arwe”, are estimates. “Mirror of Water” and “Electron Accelerator Rail Activation” have an estimated maximum of 30, but their Base and Coin Power are unknown. “Arwe”'s Power and level are also unconfirmed. Listed Power excludes conditional bonuses.

priorities.0.text: A fixed loadout of LCB Sinner Don Quixote and La Sangre de Sancho only. Adjusted to Lv.50, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV; no other Identity is needed for this encounter.

priorities.1.text: Unbreakable attacks on Turns 3 and 4 still hit after a clash win. Win clashes to prevent the extra damage from “Pallid Trace” and “Red Arwe”.

priorities.2.text: Advance to the E.G.O switch on Turn 6 instead of aiming to deplete enemy HP. A sequence ends the encounter after combat begins.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Cannot judge preparation because enemy HP and Power are hidden

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: A special encounter with hidden values. Your Sinner is adjusted to Lv.50 and Uptie IV, with bonuses from Honorable Duel. Check current clash predictions rather than judging preparation or victory conditions like a regular boss.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Taking damage despite winning the clash

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Coin I of “Faint Trace” and “Pallid Trace” is Unbreakable. Hits remain after a win, but you can prevent Coin II's Slash Fragility or extra damage.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Every skill became E.G.O on Turn 6

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: This is the encounter's scripted progression. Check the slots containing La Sangre de Sancho, begin combat, and proceed into the following sequence.

units.0.name.text: The Knight of the White Moon

units.0.notes.0.text: The part cannot be broken. This is not a normal HP-depletion kill; a sequence begins on Turn 6.

units.0.notes.1.text: At the start, the enemy gains blue Honorable Duel and Don Quixote gains yellow Honorable Duel. Do not treat their effects as identical.

phases.0.title.text: Check the fixed loadout and special buffs

phases.0.steps.0.text: Only LCB Sinner Don Quixote can deploy. Appearance Projection is unavailable, and her only E.G.O is La Sangre de Sancho. Starting SP is 45.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Yellow Honorable Duel sets max HP to 1605 and removes Stagger Thresholds. It also gives Attack Skills +15 Final Power; do not judge the clash using normal skill values alone.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Turn 1 uses “Dragon of the Spring”; Turn 2 uses “Lotus in Autumn” and “Mirror of Water”. Your slot count matches the enemy's, but the hand is random. Check clash predictions and assign skills each time.

phases.1.title.text: Prevent dangerous effects after the Unbreakable Coin

phases.1.steps.0.text: Turn 3 uses “Dragon of the Spring”, “Lotus in Autumn”, and “Faint Trace”. Beat “Faint Trace” to prevent Coin II's 3 Slash Fragility.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Turn 4 uses “Faint Trace”, “Pallid Trace”, and “Mirror of Water”. Assign a strong attack to “Pallid Trace” to prevent Coin II's extra 100 damage.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Coin I of both Trace skills is Unbreakable; a win does not prevent every hit. “Mirror of Water” is also a Clashable Guard, so do not treat it as a normal defense.

phases.2.steps.0.text: Uses “Red Arwe”, “Blak Arwe”, and “Electron Accelerator Rail Activation”. Each “Red Arwe” Coin deals 50 extra damage; each “Blak Arwe” Coin inflicts 2 Mental Fracture.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Assign a winning attack to each of the 2 “Arwe” skills. The rail buff activates at Combat Start; stopping it with an attack is not the objective.

phases.3.title.text: Advance to the sequence with the special E.G.O

phases.3.steps.0.text: The enemy uses “Arwe” without a Sin affinity, and all your slots become La Sangre de Sancho.

phases.3.steps.1.text: After combat begins, a sequence plays and the encounter ends. There is no need to interpret remaining enemy HP as insufficient damage or rebuild a normal boss-kill plan.

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Fragile next turn.

skills.0.response.text: Used on Turns 1 and 3. Clash to prevent next-turn Fragile from its hits. Winning does not stop its On Use Haste.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.

skills.1.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Fragile next turn.

skills.1.response.text: Used on Turns 2 and 3. Do not spend every strong skill on “Mirror of Water”; assign a winning attack here too.

skills.2.response.text: Used on Turns 3 and 4. A clash win prevents Coin II's Slash Fragility. Coin I is Unbreakable, so a hit remains even after a win.

skills.3.effects.0.text: If at least 5 Speed faster than the target, Clash Power +5.

skills.3.response.text: A priority clash on Turn 4. Prevent Coin II's extra damage. The bonus at a Speed difference of at least 5 means last turn's prediction may not apply.

skills.4.response.text: Used on Turn 5. Assign a winning attack to prevent each Coin's extra damage.

skills.5.response.text: Used on Turn 5. Win the clash to prevent Mental Fracture. Lower SP makes Heads less likely, so take this clash separately from “Red Arwe”.

skills.6.label.text: Clashable Guard / Power unknown / level estimated

skills.6.effects.2.text: [Clash Win] Deal HP damage equal to this skill's final Clash Power.

skills.6.response.text: Used on Turns 2 and 4. Unlike a normal Guard, an enemy clash win deals HP damage to you. Coin behavior after a clash loss is uncertain; do not assume your win removes all Protection and damage.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain 10 Attack Power Up and 10 Haste next turn.

skills.7.response.text: Used on Turn 5. The buff activates at Combat Start, so do not plan to stop it by landing an attack. Next turn advances to the scripted ending.

skills.8.label.text: No Sin affinity / Power and level unknown

skills.8.response.text: A special Turn 6 skill. All your slots become La Sangre de Sancho. Check the display and begin combat to enter the sequence and end the encounter.

passives.0.name.text: The Knight of the White Moon

passives.0.effect.text: Damage taken −20%. On Clash Lose, gain 3 Attack Power Up.

passives.0.response.text: After winning, include the enemy's Attack Power Up in subsequent predictions. Keep clashing until the scripted progression rather than trying to deplete its HP.

passives.1.condition.text: At least 10 clash rolls against the same target

passives.1.effect.text: On a clash roll, Clash Power randomly increases or decreases by the current total number of clash rolls divided by 10, rounded down.

passives.1.response.text: Power fluctuates in long clashes. More clash rolls do not guarantee an advantage.

mechanics.0.effect.text: The special yellow effect. Sets max HP to 1605 and removes Stagger Thresholds. Attack Skill Final Power +15. At Turn End, gain 5 Haste next turn.

mechanics.0.response.text: Even the fixed LCB Sinner Identity receives substantial bonuses. Judge by in-encounter predictions and HP rather than returning to raise another Identity based on normal performance.

mechanics.1.effect.text: The special blue effect gained by the enemy at the start. Detailed stat modifiers are unknown.

mechanics.1.response.text: Distinguish it from your Sinner's yellow effect despite the shared name. Do not assign its 1605 max HP or +15 Final Power to the enemy.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 5. SP Loss Efficiency +1 per 1 value. At 5, disappears and deals 10 SP damage. Decreases by 1 each turn.

mechanics.2.response.text: Each “Blak Arwe” Coin inflicts 2. Win the clash to prevent hits and limit SP loss.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Only one LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O. Adjusted to Lv.50, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV. Your slot count matches the enemy's, and the skill layout is random.

mechanics.3.response.text: You cannot use multiple allies to intercept attacks. Assign the hand to the additional slots and beat skills with dangerous extra effects.

warnings.0.text: This is not a regular boss fight won by depleting HP. Check the special progression on Turn 6.

warnings.1.text: Do not derive unknown enemy HP, Speed, level, or resistances from estimated skill levels.

warnings.2.text: Distinguish Unbreakable hits from Coin II's On Hit effects. Hits remain after a win, but clashing still matters.

warnings.3.text: “Mirror of Water”'s Coin behavior after a clash loss is uncertain. Do not assume Protection and damage always disappear.

preparation.0.text: A fixed loadout of LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O. In-encounter adjustments mean no other Identity or additional E.G.O is needed.

preparation.1.text: Check your Sinner's special buffs, random hand, and enemy skills. Adapt to each turn's clash predictions rather than assuming a fully fixed hand.

roles.0.reason.text: The only deployment slot. Receives special buffs and handles clashes against attacks with extra damage or Mental Fracture.
